summary: Full backend (19 pytest) + E2E UI test of Habit Circle. All requested flows work: signup/signin/signout, wrong-password error, top nav + sidebar nav, add habit (share unticked by default, Shared/Private badges, only own habits), habit page 7 local-date checkboxes incl. today, tick/untick updates Days done & Current streak and persists on reload, non-owner disabled checkboxes + 403, private habit 404 & hidden from community, community card shows owner/when/days, comments by other user visible to owner. ONE CRITICAL backend bug: an impossible-but-regex-valid date (e.g. 2026-02-30) is stored by PUT /ticks and then every endpoint that computes streak returns 500 — including GET /api/habits/community for ALL users.

critical.issue: Date only checked with regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$. Value like '2026-02-30' or '2026-13-45' is saved to completed_dates, then streak_of() date.fromisoformat raises -> 500 on the tick response and on every later GET /api/habits/{id}, GET /api/habits/mine (owner) and GET /api/habits/community (EVERY user, if habit is shared). One request by any user can break Community for everyone. Fix: validate with date.fromisoformat (try/except -> 400) before writing; optionally restrict to today..today-6 (or not in future). Also make streak_of tolerant of bad data.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout (playbook item); acceptable given 'keep simple' but noted.
allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True reflects any origin; prefer explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: Race: initial GET /comments can resolve after a quick POST and overwrite the list with [] so the user's just-posted comment disappears until reload (seen in fast automation; normal pacing works). Fix: functional merge or ignore stale GET.

issues: Sidebar is hidden (hidden md:flex), so sidebar buttons required by spec are not present on mobile; top nav still works.

action_items: CRITICAL: validate tick date with date.fromisoformat (400 on invalid) in PUT /api/habits/{id}/ticks; consider limiting to last 7 days and harden streak_of against bad stored values
Fix comments initial-load vs post race in HabitPage Comments
Optional: show sidebar (or a drawer) on mobile so sidebar buttons exist on every page
critical_code_review_comments: server.py tick endpoint: regex-only date validation leads to persisted invalid data and cascading 500s (see critical).
Ticks accept any date (future or years ago) via API; UI only shows last 7 days.
current_user: ObjectId(payload['sub']) would raise 500 if sub is malformed (only with forged-but-signed token; low risk).
test_credentials: alice@example.com/alice123 works. Test users created via register with test_*@example.com / secret123.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed users/habits/comments. Manually removed 2 invalid completed_dates from DB (created by my test reproducing the bug) because they broke /api/habits/community for everyone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_habit_tracker.py. test_impossible_date_does_not_break_habit should pass after fix (NOTE: until fixed, running it pollutes DB and breaks community; clean completed_dates). Browser timezone in test env showed 2026-10-31.
rca of the issue: DATE_RE only checks shape; $addToSet stores '2026-02-30'; habit_out -> streak_of -> date.fromisoformat ValueError -> unhandled 500. Community lists all shared habits through habit_out so a single bad habit fails the whole list. Repro: register, create shared habit, PUT /ticks {date:'2026-02-30',done:true} -> 500; GET /api/habits/community -> 500. Mitigation: parse date strictly before update.
